items.x: Strong surf pounding Palm Beach County’s coastline has damaged the historic Jupiter Civic Center at Carlin Park, forcing the building to close as crews take emergency measures to protect the nearly 100-year-old structure.

items.x: A man who played a major role in defrauding a federal food program in Minnesota was sentenced Wednesday to 30 years in prison.

items.t: Cracked: In South Texas, new Congressional lines divide neighbors
items.x: Neighbors on the same street in Corpus Christi, Texas, will soon have different representatives in Congress. A new Republican-drawn map is dividing communities, and some residents aren't happy.

items.t: 83-year-old prepares for 51st NYC Marathon
items.x: David Obelkevich is the only person to complete every NYC Marathon since 1976. He's going for his 51st consecutive race this weekend.
